visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a woman sitting in a dimly lit room, illuminated by a purple circular sunset lamp in the background. She wears a grey t-shirt with a German Shepherd graphic and acts out being extremely tired and hungry, yawning and clutching her stomach while sitting at a glass desk. (2) She enthusiastically presents a white portable electric kettle from NICONICO alongside a red cup of Nongshim Tonkotsu instant noodles. Close-ups emphasize the product's 480ml capacity and its ability to handle global voltages from 100 to 240V, showing the sleek white exterior and digital base. (3) She demonstrates the ease of use by pouring clear bottled water into the open top of the kettle. The camera zooms in on the digital interface at the base, showing touch buttons and temperature readings shifting between 100, 90, and 70 degrees. (4) A graphical overlay lists various uses for specific temperatures: 100C for noodles, 90C for coffee, 80C for desserts, and 55C for milk. She then pours steaming water into her cup noodles, showing the practical application of the kettle in a home setting. (5) The woman is shown eating the noodles with great relish using wooden chopsticks, looking upward with an expression of intense satisfaction. Fast-paced variety text overlays emphasize her enjoyment. The video concludes with promotional slides showing product specifications, pricing, and her Instagram profile screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice singing a tired, exaggerated melody in Traditional Chinese to set a late-night atmosphere. (2) Energetic pop music with a strong electronic beat fades in, and the female speaker switches to a high-pitched, enthusiastic narrative tone explaining the portable kettle's features. (3) Mechanical and digital beeping UI sounds are heard clearly as the device's temperature settings are adjusted. (4) Distinct pop sound effects punctuate the visual appearance of product icons and text graphics. (5) A liquid splash sound is heard as water is poured, followed by loud percussive slurping and crunching sounds as the speaker eats the noodles. (6) High-energy exclamation and laughter are heard, followed by a final professional call-to-action with the music continuing until a hard cut at the end.
